sections.heading: What to prepare for your own boardroom refurbishment
paragraphs: Start with a measured room plan, the furniture and joinery you want to retain or change, the people using the room and the requirements you need the appointed team to assess.

Keep the table, seating and joinery scope clear when comparing proposals. If technology, building services or construction work is also needed, identify those workstreams and the appropriate appointments separately.
Agree the business brief and budget before committing to products or work. The scope, delivery arrangements and responsibilities should be confirmed for the actual project.

closing.heading: Planning a boardroom refurbishment?
paragraphs: Tell us where the project stands, what needs changing and what you would like the room to do. YOS can discuss the furniture and joinery brief and whether an agreed client-side project management scope would be useful.
YOS does not act as the builder or head contractor. Appointed contractors and specialist advisers retain their respective responsibilities.
